conventions.parameter_metric: R = diag(||J_col||^2) of the full candidate pool per (M, d); whitened metrics use J R^{-1/2}; raw metrics use J unchanged
conventions.prior: standard normal in each declared coordinate convention
conventions.qfi_weights: q = 1/s^2, packet widths log-uniform(0.05, 0.20) per registered seed
conventions.blocking: pinned worst-case 20% contiguous angular sector per seed
conventions.coverage: MC calibration on representative cells only (300 trials, raw coords)
